author: Splaezer
quote:
This game is a travesty in every sense of the word. The opening cutscene didn't load properly, paused, then continued and then replayed itself, the inconsistent 30 FPS is criminal considering the dev time and budget of this game, the 1st 20 hours or something of gameplay is doing chores and the game itself doesn't feel like GTA 6 but Red Dead Redemption 2 if it was set in the modern day. I the series is named after a literal felony and yet this game makes it it's absolute mission that I don't accomplish that. A bunch of clunk was added like food, water, fitness and all that stat junk, now when you break into a car instead of a smooth breaking in animation you have to do each step individually including booting it up with that terrible """"minigame"""" that stops all action and fun, fuel is also a thing for no reason and probably more clunky features I missed. The unstable 30 FPS is also unbearable with even scenes where literally nothing happens have the frame rate dip to single digits. A bunch of features that were in GTA 5 were also removed, with most of them being criminal activities like buying hookers which feels like cowardice from the company.

This game is terrible and I want a refund. Oh wait, you can't get a refund! Once you opened the game you're unable to refund the game! Thanks Sony and Rockstar! These companies are terrible and deserve all the bad press they're getting. I hope this game fails but who am I kidding, it's probably going to win all the awards it was nominated for in the Game Awards because then they'll be blacklisted! What the hell is this?! Why is this allowed to happen?!

In conclusion, **** this game and everything it represents.
